title: Post-Diarra landscape: what clubs and agents should watch in 2026
excerpt: The CJEU cases (C-209/23 & C-428/23) continue to reshape the validity and scope of the 2023 FFAR. Early signals from FIFA Tribunal practice suggest a more cautious approach to certain agent fee structures.

title: Article 17 RSTP after the latest DRC guidance — three practical takeaways
excerpt: Recent DRC decisions show increased scrutiny on 'just cause' arguments based on non-payment of image rights. Clubs are being held to stricter standards on contractual stability post-Diarra.
